info.title: Wolfari Finance Contributions
info.description: Implemented API078-084 and API087-089 for shared group activity funds. Manual confirmation records the full issued amount after the current Holder checks their bank externally. No automatic bank verification, provider callback, partial payment, reversal or refund writer. Local service-secret transport rejects production mode. API086 provides Self-only TEST VietQR QuickLink instructions from the issued destination snapshot. The external image request discloses recipient/amount/reference to Casso; no automatic payment verification.

post.description: Owner only, active Trip and OPEN Fund, durable Trip guard. Allocations, finance version increment, audit, receipt and ContributionRequested outbox entry commit atomically. Balance/ledger unchanged. Repeat with the same Idempotency-Key and identical normalized payload. Current membership is rechecked on replay. 202 means poll GET /api/v1/operations/{operation_id}, then retry the original POST with the original key; do not issue a new key after an uncertain result.

get.description: Current active Member/Owner/Holder only; TRIP_VIEW checked on every page. Archived Trips and CLOSING/CLOSED Funds remain readable. Fixed created_at DESC, id DESC, microsecond keyset. Newer inserts are excluded from continuation. Mutable statuses mean this is not a snapshot export; refresh for latest state. Unknown or duplicate query keys and GET bodies are rejected. No operation, ledger, receipt, event or version is written. Complete nested allocations are never truncated; transport limits can return 503; reducing the outer limit cannot split a single oversized request.

patch.description: OPEN request. Title/note may change with mixed child states. A changed due_at requires every child PENDING, no original receipt and no unresolved/succeeded attempt. Omitted fields retain old values; explicit null rejected; clearing due_at is not supported. Actual changes increment request and finance versions; child versions unchanged. Emit ContributionUpdated per PENDING/TRANSFER_REPORTED child, unique IDs with the same aggregate version. Active Owner only, OPEN Fund and active Trip without closure lock. Server resolves Fund/Trip from contribution ID. Idempotency key, entity version and finance version required. No balance or ledger mutation. A normalized no-op still checks permission, state and versions and saves a receipt, without audit/event/version changes. For 202, poll GET /api/v1/operations/{operation_id} then retry the original method/body/key. Replay returns the saved snapshot after current read permission is checked.

post.description: Current active Holder only: CONFIRMED to REVERSED. Append one exact opposite OUT REVERSAL linked to the original CONTRIBUTION ledger entry, then reduce Fund balance. This is an accounting correction, not a bank refund. The original ledger, confirmation and evidence remain immutable. Fund/request must be OPEN and Trip active without closure lock. Reserved PENDING/HOLDER_REPORTED refunds remain unavailable, so reversal fails when available balance is insufficient. Expected contribution and Finance versions plus UUID Idempotency-Key are required. Replay rechecks the current Holder; a contribution can be reversed once only.

post.description: Self only: PENDING to TRANSFER_REPORTED; no balance/ledger change. Optional evidence must be a READY file uploaded by Self in this Fund and unbound, or exactly the currently attached file. Verify storage before the write. Omitted evidence preserves the previous key; null/blank cannot clear it. Replaced evidence remains bound for history. Active member; OPEN Fund/request, active Trip without closure lock. Owner has no override. Expected entity and Finance versions plus UUID Idempotency-Key required. Block unresolved/succeeded provider attempts and an existing original ledger entry. Every transition increments contribution and Finance versions, not request version. Persist state, audit, outbox, command receipt and any ledger/file binding atomically. Retry the identical body/key after 202 and poll the operation. Replay returns the saved snapshot after current Self/Holder permission checks. Public data excludes evidence keys and bank details.

get.description: Only PENDING, OPEN Fund/request, active Trip/membership and explicit unlocked closure context. Owner/Holder have no Self override. No writes. Existing downloaded QR cannot be revoked. MoMo is unsupported here. UI must show TEST/warning and load images with no-referrer. TEST is not a bank sandbox: never use real accounts for demonstrations.

200.description: Private TEST instruction; showing a QR does not prove payment.

Money.description: Positive integer VND, at most 9223372036854775807. Always a string; never convert to JavaScript Number.

LegacyCreatedRequest.description: Only for replay of receipts issued before the full response increment. Does not contain contributions or finance_version. No live rows are used to reconstruct historical data.

ContributionRequest.description: GET includes every allocation of the request; finance_version is captured with the page in one SQL snapshot. created_by_user_id, created_at, amount_per_member and closed_at are compatibility metadata extensions.

CreatedRequest.description: Saved creation snapshot: OPEN/version 1, allocations PENDING/version 1, finance_version at commit. Retrying returns the saved snapshot even after later changes. Nullable allocation timestamps, confirmer and reasons are null at creation.

title.description: Nonblank; no NUL. Counted in Unicode code points.

amount.description: Positive int64 VND; leading zeroes accepted and normalized.

contributions.description: Unique active members; each destination belongs to this Fund, is active and confirmed by Holder.

due_at.description: Explicit offset and seconds, up to 9 fractional digits accepted, stored at millisecond precision. Metadata only; no automatic debit or cancellation.

note.description: May be empty, may not contain NUL. Omit to represent no note; explicit null rejected.
